name: pe_info
description: Read an executable's structure without running it: PE headers, sections with their entropy and permissions, imports and exports, the compile timestamp and the certificate directory; for ELF the header, sections, segments and DT_NEEDED libraries; for Mach-O the load commands and linked libraries.

path.description: A PE, ELF or Mach-O file

with_imports.description: Resolve imported function names as well as library names (default true)
